_comment: Shared hint catalog — single source of truth for pill hint TEXT on BOTH platforms. The container is generic per platform (React WebView pill on Windows via src/pill/HintPopup.tsx; native Swift pill on macOS via macos-native/.../PillModel.swift); both read this file, so add a hint here once and neither renderer hardcodes text. Per entry: `platform` (optional: 'both' (default) | 'windows' | 'macos') controls which pill shows it; `title`/`body` are either a plain string (identical on both) OR an object { "windows": "…", "macos": "…" } when the text differs by OS (e.g. keybinds — Ctrl+Shift+Space vs fn+Space). Interactive hints with their own controls (screenshot_prompt buttons, prompt_hint keyword) are NOT here — they are bespoke containers, not plain title/body.

voice_commands.title: Control by voice
voice_commands.body: Say “zephyr stop” or “zephyr send” while recording.

apple_shortcuts.title: Run Shortcuts
apple_shortcuts.body: Say “shortcut” and the Shortcut name to run an automation.

vocabulary.title: Teach names once
vocabulary.body: Add vocabulary and “sounds like” aliases for reliable names and terms.

snippets.title: Speak saved snippets
snippets.body: Create reusable text snippets and insert them by voice.

ai_polish.title: Polish and undo
ai_polish.body: Use AI polish, then undo or redo from the transcript pill.

file_transcription.title: Transcribe a file
file_transcription.body: Open HeardRight to transcribe an audio or video file.

groq_key.title: AI polish is Pro
groq_key.body: AI polish sends text to your provider. Add a provider key on Polish to use it.

mini_clipboard.title: Recent text stays close
mini_clipboard.body: Open History on the pill to copy one of your last three transcripts.

stop_and_send.title: Paste and send in one go

body.windows: Press Ctrl+Shift+Space to paste your dictation and send it.
body.macos: Press fn ⇧ Space to paste your dictation and send it.

cancel_saved.title: Saved to History
cancel_saved.body: Find it under the Cancelled tab.
